title: W06d: diagnostic catalog declarations for the new families
description: Declare every new diagnostic the plan requires, with severity, message, hint and class-level retryability, in the single core catalog, and name the existing codes the feature reuses instead of inventing synonyms: multiple_active_claims, claim_status_divergence, duplicate_id, invalid_commit_ref, no_git_claim_match, ambiguous_git_claim, no_active_claim, claim_owner_mismatch, task_done, invalid_transition, no_such_task, lock_contended, mutation_intent_invalid, ledger_not_found, git_not_repository, git_command_failed and unexpected_error. Cover the families of plan 14: Git input and source, intent, evidence, ledger, transfer, read model and adapter. Plugin-specific routing errors stay in the plugin's own namespaced catalog rather than copying business validation into the plugin.
acceptance: Every family in plan 14 has its required distinctions as named codes, and each code carries severity, message, hint and retryability.
No consumer duplicates a catalogued code and no new code restates an existing code's meaning.
Core-origin errors remain core diagnostics, while plugin routing errors use a namespaced catalog and never copy business validation.
Tests assert the catalog's shape and the absence of duplicates rather than freezing message text.
notes: src/core/result.ts is the catalog; the CLI, MCP and the plugin consume it, so declare before consumers need it.
